meta.title: Regional Preventive Health Analytics
meta.data_boundary: Official aggregate open data only; no patient-level records.
meta.interpretation_boundary: Descriptive and exploratory planning analysis. Forecasts are not clinical predictions; hypotheses are not causal findings.
meta.cross_country_warning: UK QOF registered prevalence and US BRFSS age-adjusted prevalence use different populations and methods and must not be directly ranked against each other.

diabetes.title: Age and population structure
diabetes.investigation_prompt: Check whether older age composition helps explain the observed aggregate prevalence pattern.
diabetes.interpretation_guardrail: Age is a known risk factor; source-specific age adjustment does not remove all contextual confounding.

diabetes.title: Obesity and physical activity context
diabetes.investigation_prompt: Compare obesity, physical activity, food access and deprivation indicators before prioritising prevention research.
diabetes.interpretation_guardrail: Co-occurrence at area level does not establish causality.

hypertension.title: Detection and recording intensity
hypertension.investigation_prompt: Review screening, diagnosis and recording completeness alongside the prevalence signal.
hypertension.interpretation_guardrail: Higher measured prevalence can partly reflect detection and recording.

hypertension.title: Cardiometabolic context
hypertension.investigation_prompt: Examine obesity, physical inactivity, diabetes and age structure as candidate contextual contributors.
hypertension.interpretation_guardrail: These are population-level research prompts, not patient risk factors.

copd.title: Smoking history
copd.investigation_prompt: Compare current and historical tobacco exposure with respiratory prevalence.
copd.interpretation_guardrail: The dashboard does not estimate attributable fractions.

copd.title: Air and occupational exposures
copd.investigation_prompt: Review air quality and the regional mix of occupations involving dust, fumes or other respiratory hazards.
copd.interpretation_guardrail: Exposure data are not included in the current model.

chd.title: Cardiometabolic risk-factor mix
chd.investigation_prompt: Assess hypertension, diabetes, smoking, obesity and age structure together.
chd.interpretation_guardrail: A regional association cannot identify an individual's cause.

chd.title: Access and deprivation context
chd.investigation_prompt: Review preventive-care access, deprivation and treatment continuity indicators.
chd.interpretation_guardrail: Service access is not measured directly in this release.

cancer.title: Age, incidence and survival
cancer.investigation_prompt: Separate age structure, new diagnoses and survival before interpreting a registered prevalence difference.
cancer.interpretation_guardrail: Prevalence is not incidence and may rise when survival improves.

cancer.title: Screening and detection
cancer.investigation_prompt: Compare screening uptake and stage-at-diagnosis data before drawing conclusions.
cancer.interpretation_guardrail: Detection patterns can change measured prevalence.

asthma.title: Air quality and housing context
asthma.investigation_prompt: Review air pollution, damp housing, occupational exposures and smoking context.
asthma.interpretation_guardrail: These exposures are not measured in the current dataset.

depression.title: Social and economic context
depression.investigation_prompt: Compare employment, isolation, housing stress and access to mental-health care.
depression.interpretation_guardrail: Survey or register prevalence also reflects help-seeking and recording.

obesity.title: Food and activity environments
obesity.investigation_prompt: Review affordable food access, safe activity space, transport and local design.
obesity.interpretation_guardrail: Obesity is multifactorial; no single area feature is sufficient.

obesity.title: Economic stability and care access
obesity.investigation_prompt: Compare deprivation, economic stability, housing and access to preventive care.
obesity.interpretation_guardrail: Area-level context should not be used to profile individuals.
